required_outcomes: Recognises the conflict: the ticket records the Swift visit on 14 October 2026, the tenant reports a text from Swift for Sunday 11 October 08:00–10:00.
Checks with Swift Plumbing & Heating which date is real rather than choosing one silently.
Tells the tenant he does not need to miss his hospital appointment, and that the visit will be confirmed or moved to a time he can do.
Creates no new ticket and does not escalate.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking Swift to keep or revert to 14 October because the tenant is unavailable Sunday morning.
Asking the tenant for a screenshot of the text while checking with Swift.
positive_behaviours: Updates the ticket or adds a note once the date is clarified, or records that it is pending.
Schedules a follow-up to confirm the date with the tenant.
red_flags: Telling the tenant to be in tomorrow.
Telling him the text must be wrong without checking.
prohibited_actions: Cancelling or re-booking the job with a different contractor.
critical_failures: Confirming a date to the tenant that neither the record nor the contractor has confirmed.
